notes: G6 evaluates the frozen D17-G candidate on the full soft-label target time grid.
Use --max_time_points 0 and --time_window_s 0 for the true full all-cycle audit.
Start with --profile_limit 1 for smoke because full 55-cell evaluation can be I/O heavy.
By default predictions are not saved; use --save_predictions compressed_npz only for small selected subsets.
